notes.title: Extra Coin v1.3.0 - Patch Notes 🎮
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Extra Coin v1.3.0 is here, and we're excited to share it with you!

This update marks the end of the bugfixing and polishing phase, delivering the best possible gameplay experience with deep polish, enhanced narrative flow and pacing, and fixing bugs reported by our amazing community. We truly appreciate all your support in helping us make the game better.

⚠️ This patch will also be released for the Switch version as soon as possible (about 2 weeks, if we are lucky with the certification process).

As always, you can follow the progress of our bug fixes in our [url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/b/h/6-901506132711-2/b9e26a085970784\]Bugfixing Roadmap[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38801073/9a07f3c8441d7bf8c44148444064c4b676f2dbe4.png[/img]

[h2]Patch Details[/h2]

- [b]Tons of polishing fixes[/b], with [b]improved direction and timing throughout the story[/b]
- Fixed autosave breaking the loop even [[url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/t/h/86c0qxnnr/MR343D9BF4LQUMQ]reported by Lucaffo, puppamilaspranga, WildSpamtonFan[/url]]
- Fixed a bug preventing the break loop path from continuing when saving the game under certain conditions [[url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/t/h/86c0zjaw1/YZ7G04PMGUK671A]reported by Frank Lioty[/url]]
- Fixed Mika IRL on break loop events if occurring after a login [[url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/t/h/86c0yzc12/REU3XQM8CZOZC67]reported by Althura[/url]]
- Fixed save dates updating every time upon reaching the main menu [[url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/t/h/86c0zq49c/EJHJEHXVM7MNQD1]reported by Lucaffo[/url]]
- Fixed a bug that blocked the game if the player paused during field swapping in duels [[url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/t/h/86c0rk6x6/ZLW6FLL3D1VBTH8]reported by Althura[/url]]
- Fixed duplicated Mika visible on the field after closing the leaderboard view [[url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/t/h/86c0ewdpc/CL5MMQO0X3X851O]reported by Althura[/url]]
- Fixed panorama interaction not being restored after the Gardens event in chapter 4 [[url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/t/h/86c0zpn9v/A545R8505T9H7I7]reported by Kitos[/url]]
- Fixed missing music when looking at the photo in Marsh's apartment [[url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/t/h/86c0ewhj1/PPDUKAVBT2F86FN]reported by Althura[/url]]

[h2]Moving Forward[/h2]

Thank you again for your amazing support. We're planning to take a short break before resuming support for the game. Our next steps will focus on balancing minigames and duels difficulty, as well as introducing new features. We can't wait for you to dive in. 🔥

Join our Discord for exclusive updates and to connect with the community: [url=https://discord.gg/cinicgames\]link[/url]

Game on,
CINIC Games 🎮

notes.title: Extra Coin v1.2.5 - Patch Notes 🎮
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

The fifth patch is here, and we're excited to share it with you! This update brings a number of important fixes, including improved objective tracking, corrected boss fight arenas, and restored missing dialogues, all thanks to your invaluable feedback. We truly appreciate all your support in helping us make the game better.

As always, you can follow the progress of our bug fixes in our [url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/b/h/6-901506132711-2/b9e26a085970784]Bugfixing Roadmap[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38801073/bec94e1de04c67f02803bfd17cd761130a873064.png[/img]

[h2]Patch Details[/h2]

- Fixed all issues related to objectives and tasks [[url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/t/h/86c0t3bb9/OCD5DWB7X3OOJ96]reported by Althura[/url]]
- Fixed narrative blocks incorrectly reappearing after leaving and returning to a location in the next loop [[url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/t/h/86c0nmq8k/Z84XAVEXT5W4MCH]reported by Althura[/url]]
- Removed surrender button during "narrative" duels to avoid game-breaking issues [[url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/t/h/86c0jgy6u/DLBU5LVEIJ46DEC]reported by Althura[/url]]
- Fixed missing OxO's dialogues [[url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/t/h/86bzk9vcn/OBQ010KWUQTLP1F]reported by Giacomo Montagnoli, Giox, SteVieh445, Tournesol, .in the sky[/url]]
- Fixed Marsh standing still after loading a save in the cat cafe [[url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/t/h/86c0w9aky/8EE7Q3HD133KJSJ]reported by Althura[/url]]
- Fixed wrong arena when retrying a boss fight against a champion [[url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/t/h/86c0g6xmh/HMH80FLY34PZ70K]reported by Frank Lioty[/url]]

[h2]Moving Forward[/h2]

Thank you again for your amazing support. We initially planned to complete the bugfixing with this patch, but we had to split it due to a critical bug introduced in v1.2.4 that required an immediate fix. The remaining bug fixes will be included in [b]v1.2.6[/b]. Once v1.2.6 is released, we will proceed to update the Switch version as well. 🔥

Join our Discord for exclusive updates and to connect with the community: [url=https://discord.gg/cinicgames]link[/url]

Game on,
CINIC Games 🎮

notes.title: Extra Coin v1.2.4 - Patch Notes 🎮
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
We're excited to bring you our latest patch, packed with fixes for bugs and issues that many of you have helped us identify. Your feedback continues to be incredibly valuable, and we truly appreciate your support 🙏

As always, you can follow the progress of our bug fixes in our [url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/b/h/6-901506132711-2/b9e26a085970784]Bugfixing Roadmap[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38801073/74c55bdc99e3f3a64e3493d74ce1bc25f68d038e.jpg[/img]

Here are the details of what we've fixed this time:

[*] fixed a bug causing narrative blocks to be reproduced again in certain circumstances after loading a save [[url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/t/h/86c0n41qf/AIONF4WF6IMMV95]reported by SteVieh445, Althura[/url]]
[*] after interacting with a hotspot, its icon now reappears to indicate it’s ready for interaction again [[url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/t/h/86c0k7p37/BJ6A3ZSFECXL44C]reported by Frank Lioty[/url]]
[*] fixed an issue causing the dialogue sound to loop unexpectedly [[url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/t/h/86c0ge24n/U7FDKVEG4WS1JG9]reported by Althura[/url]]
[*] fixed balloons out of screen [[url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/t/h/86c0n3zt0/OZIKBBFHDZ56VQ5]reported by El Sans que gira, Lucaffo[/url]]
[*] fixed random bubbling sound randomly muted from time to time [[url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/t/h/86c0tzkvu/88DAI57C9MPOH6V]reported by Frank Lioty[/url]]
[*] the mouse pointer is now confined to the game view to prevent accidental clicks outside of it on multiple screens [[url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/t/h/86c0u479v/UTIPZMAJTSPGGFQ]reported by s0ca[/url]]
[*] fixed missing Arrow when leaving the location and then returning on the next duel loop [[url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/t/h/86c0w8g16/ORAD8QCMW1B7CD3]reported by Althura[/url]]
[*] fixed missing subtitles in endings [[url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/t/h/86c0k7rwf/R4RN2Z16A8554HJ]reported by Althura[/url]]
[*] added confirmation popup before starting a minigame [[url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/t/h/86c0u50rf/C0G3JDZSXF4DPL5]suggested by Lucaffo[/url]]
[*] added missing game icon [[url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/t/h/86c0u4zxq/HK87P21NR9ZF7HH]reported by Lucaffo[/url]]
[*] fixed an issue preventing Skinny to keep talking after interacting with him [[url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/t/h/86c0r2y11/OK9TZIEHLFRGMY5]reported by Althura[/url]]
[*] fixed ball color in The Doctor arena to make it more visible [[url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/t/h/86c0twrgy/XSETPGRQO36HROX]reported by Matteo Agostini[/url]]
[*] added missing terminal boot sounds [[url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/t/h/86c0jfagw/5Q7JKUDX581JWWD]reported by Giacomo Montagnoli[/url]]
[*] fixed infinite walk after unpausing the game/closing the diary [[url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/t/h/86c00w6f9/XC0CWQXOMTHQ3HZ]reported by Lucaffo, SteVieh445, El Sans que gira, Frobby[/url]]
[*] fixed barman's wrong animation when interacting with him [[url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/t/h/86c0t2nue/8K1MESIDEYI187J]reported by Althura[/url]]
[*] fixed Mika standing on her bed one frame before the nightmare cinematics [[url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/t/h/86c0qxamk/B86RO1PFFSYUNUP]reported by Althura[/url]]
[*] fixed Penny's floating face if saving/reloading after his show but before talking to Ranflaggdall [[url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/t/h/86c0u50pg/OGMCRVVUH7DNDSA]reported by El Sans que gira[/url]]
[*] fixed typo in Green Polish description (English) [[url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/t/h/86c0u503n/QB6X1CBO4RLF4UP]reported by WildSpamtonFan[/url]]
[*] fixed typo in Action Figure description (Italian) [[url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/t/h/86c0t1xrn/0YT9EWL2LZNELSW]reported by Althura[/url]]
[*] minor fixes to UI

Thank you again for your amazing support. This patch fixes most of the remaining major bugs. We expect to complete the bug fixes/polish in the next patch. Once [b]v1.2.5[/b] is released, we will proceed to update the Switch version too.  🔥

Join our Discord to get YOUR second chance: [url=https://discord.gg/cinicgames]link[/url]

Game on,
CINIC Games 🎮

notes.title: Extra Coin v1.2.3 - Patch Notes 🎮
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
We're back with our third patch, addressing more bugs and issues that you all helped us uncover. Your feedback has been invaluable, and we're incredibly grateful for your support 🙏 

As before, you can check the progress of bug fixes in our [url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/b/h/6-901506132711-2/b9e26a085970784\]Bugfixing Roadmap[/url]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38801073/c878fa4bde28a3f1f089b33b31f0ac9c90f41142.png[/img]

Here are the details of what we've fixed this time:

[*] added all SFX to the UI
[*] fixed a blocking issue after Moloch encounter at the end of chapter 4 [[url=https://app.clickup.com/t/86c0n4ea9]reported by Mr_Unlisted, Jyo, ravnosalex, SteVieh44[/url]]
[*] fixed a bug when loading a save and switching input in the map view [[url=https://app.clickup.com/t/86c0jfbz6]reported by puppamilaspranga, Giacomo Montagnoli[/url]]
[*] removed stats cap [[url=https://app.clickup.com/t/86c0nbu87]reported by SteVieh445[/url]]
[*] fixed incorrect credit numbers for vendors and diary/profile [[url=https://app.clickup.com/t/86c0nc426]reported by SteVieh445[/url]]
[*] fixed difficulty sliders "moving" in other UI views [[url=https://app.clickup.com/t/86c0ncmmb]reported by El Sans que gira, SteVieh445[/url]]
[*] fixed tiny passive icon when the overall passive slot amount is two [[url=https://app.clickup.com/t/86c0q2jmy]reported by Althura[/url]]
[*] fixed Mika's profile not updating in the diary after changing her build [[url=https://app.clickup.com/t/86c0q6y7d]reported by Moreno Lovato[/url]]
[*] fixed shard location in the loft (chapter 5), hiding behind Arrow [[url=https://app.clickup.com/t/86c0qb7um]reported by Waven87[/url]]
[*] fixed a bug causing multiple purchases [[url=https://app.clickup.com/t/86c0qx5yv]reported by Waven87[/url]]
[*] fixed a game-breaking issue when you win 1 game but then lose during boss fights [[url=https://app.clickup.com/t/86c0qx8kf]reported by Frank Lioty[/url]]
[*] fixed a bug causing the medallion to be removed in the cosmetic setup view [[url=https://app.clickup.com/t/86c0rbjjm]reported by Frank Lioty[/url]]
[*] fixed a typo in the English localization for a cosmetic name [[url=https://app.clickup.com/t/86c0qvxu7]reported by WildSpamtonFan[/url]]

As always thank you for the great support. We are very close to completing the most urgent bug fixes, which will allow us to start working on some missing features and balancing, starting from next patch [b]v1.2.4[/b]  🔥

Join our Discord to get YOUR second chance: [url=https://discord.gg/cinicgames]link[/url]

Game on,
CINIC Games 🎮

notes.title: Extra Coin v1.2.2 - Patch Notes 🎮
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
We're back with our second patch, addressing more bugs and issues that you all helped us uncover. We're incredibly grateful for all your detailed reports and feedback. 

As before, you can check the progress of bug fixes in our [url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/b/h/6-901506132711-2/b9e26a085970784\]Bugfixing Roadmap[/url]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38801073/7fc29c16d9a7936e298792c20f04dc3156d81503.jpg[/img]

Here are the details of what we've fixed this time:

[*] After Arrow scene at the movie theater, the seat interaction is now restored, avoiding breaking the game ([u][b]non-compatible with on-going runs[/b][/u]) [[url=https://app.clickup.com/t/86c0n1vft\]reported by SteVieh445, El Sans que gira, Vit, Crispeta[/url]]
[*] Fixed an issue which breaks the game when the player tries to move to a place where a competitor is wearing the astronaut helmet, causing "the-blackscreen-of-death" [[url=https://app.clickup.com/t/86c0nhj22\]reported by El Sans que gira[/url]]
[*] Subtasks are no longer duplicated along tasks in diary [[url=https://app.clickup.com/t/86c0nbrk0\]reported by Ides, Lucaffo, SteVieh445[/url]]
[*] Climbing minigame score is fixed between HUD and recap screen [[url=https://app.clickup.com/t/86c0nbw14\]reported by SteVieh445[/url]]
[*] After restarting the game, the game language is no longer reset to English [[url=https://app.clickup.com/t/86c0n414c\]reported by El Sans que gira[/url]]
[*] After the Arcade museum tour, the receptionist stops you, avoiding a second (broken) visit [[url=https://app.clickup.com/t/86c0f4qhe\]reported by SteVieh445[/url]]
[*] Dialogue balloons now fit in-screen [[url=https://app.clickup.com/t/86c0n3zt0\]reported by El Sans que gira, Lucaffo[/url]]
[*] Entering/exiting the vendor menu doesn't cause wrong zoom/position camera anymore [[url=https://app.clickup.com/t/86c0ethye\]reported by El Sans que gira, SteVieh445[/url]]
[*] Removed map placeholder on Bonus Stage Gardens after an encounter in chapter 5 [[url=https://app.clickup.com/t/86c0n4cdz\]reported by coso_man[/url]]
[*] Fixed out-of-screen input prompts in vendor view [[url=https://app.clickup.com/t/86c0n4g9y\]reported by SteVieh445[/url]]
[*] Fixed Mika/Bleed compenetration after Bleed moved next to the barman in chapter 2 [[url=https://app.clickup.com/t/86c0n3zhm\]reported by El Sans que gira[/url]]
[*] Fixed an Italian typo when Mika reads the origami in chapter 2 [[url=https://app.clickup.com/t/86c0n4b8t\]reported by El Sans que gira[/url]]


We're already working on patch 1.2.3, which will include more bugfixing as well as an assisted mode for those playing at 'Bookworm' difficulty, and the addition of windowed mode.


Join our Discord to get YOUR second chance: [url=https://discord.gg/cinicgames]link[/url]

notes.title: Extra Coin v1.2.1 - Patch Notes 🎮
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
We're delighted to see the support and engagement since the launch of [i]Extra Coin[/i]! 
Your feedback and reports have been incredibly helpful in identifying several issues and allowing us to fix all the bugs. We have made our QA board public where we are collecting every bug you have reported. This way, you can check the progress of bug fixes over time. 

You can find the board here: [url=https://sharing.clickup.com/6628443/b/h/6-901506132711-2/b9e26a085970784]Bugfixing Roadmap[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38801073/8489510a2cc2ced221d8bb686899118d7b46a248.png[/img]

Today, we’re rolling out our first patch, with some important fixes based on your input. Check out the details below and keep sharing your thoughts with us!

[list]
[*] water dominance achievement is now unlockable [[url=https://app.clickup.com/t/86c0mx3bd]reported by El Sans que gira[/url]]
[*] fixed non-stopping ultimate sound during duel [[url=https://app.clickup.com/t/86c0k7utd]reported by Giox, SteVieh445, Lucaffo, Vit and almost everyone[/url]]
[*] fixed expression/gesture when making fortune teller activity
[*] fixed missing dialogue line talking with OxO at the beginning of chapter 2 [[url=https://app.clickup.com/t/86c0mx3a7]reported by Lucaffo, SteVieh445[/url]]
[*] map and shard location orders are now the same [[url=https://app.clickup.com/t/86c0mxa8h]reported by SteVieh445[/url]]
[*] fixed wrong tag in main street minigame instruction [[url=https://app.clickup.com/t/86c0mwwf5]reported by SteVieh445, Lucaffo[/url]]
[*] fixed a typo in fortune teller minigame instruction [[url=https://app.clickup.com/t/86c0n077d]reported by SteVieh445[/url]]
[*] fixed duplicated dialogue line talking with Bleed during chapter 5 [[url=https://app.clickup.com/t/86c0n07y3]reported by SteVieh445[/url]]
[/list]

notes.title: Target Release + Closed Beta Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hey there, gamers!

It's been a while since our last update, but we want you to know that the game is still alive and kicking!  Over the past two years, we've been working hard behind the scenes to make some significant improvements. And guess what? We're getting close to the finish line! 💜

We're excited to announce that [b]we're aiming to release Extra Coin on Q1 2024[/b] 🤩. We know it's been a long wait, and we appreciate your patience. We've been fine-tuning the gameplay, tweaking mechanics, and making sure that every aspect of the game is top-notch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38801073/87043a3b05a2a777e513f5e85d589d9d82744ff6.gif[/img]

[h2]Join our upcoming closed beta[/h2]

But that's not all! We've been listening to your feedback and suggestions, and we want to show our appreciation. Soon, we'll be launching a closed beta and it will be exclusively available to our newsletter subscribers 🙌 So make sure you're signed up to get a chance to play the game before anyone else!

But how to opt-in? Pretty simple! 👇👇👇
[url=https://discord.gg/cinigames]Join our Discord server[/url]. Once there, head over to the #beta-signup channel. A 'Sign Up Now' button is there waiting for you ✌️

Stay tuned for more updates and sneak peeks in the upcoming weeks. We're grateful to have you on this adventure with us!

Game on,
CINIC Games
